entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Ava, how can I help you today?
Yes, I need to return something. And honestly, I'm already pretty annoyed. This better be easy.
I understand your frustration, sir. I'll do everything I can to make this a smooth process. Can you tell me what item you're looking to return?
It's the VeloBand Pulse smart watch. I got it a little over two weeks ago, and it just isn't working for me. The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. I want my money back.
I understand. So you're looking to return your VeloBand Pulse. Can you provide me with your order number, please?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order. You purchased the VeloBand Pulse 15 days ago. No problem at all, sir. Our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase, as long as the item is in good condition.
Ninety days? Seriously? That's it? Finally, some good news. I was expecting a huge hassle. It's practically brand new, I barely used it.

Yes, sir, 90 days. So the return of your VeloBand Pulse is definitely within our policy. I can go ahead and process the return for you. Would you prefer a refund to your original payment method, or store credit?
Refund, definitely refund. I'm done with this thing.

Okay, refund it is. I've processed the return. You should see the refund reflected in your account within 7-10 business days. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label in your email within the next hour. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
That's it? Really? No arguing, no hoops to jump through? Amazing. Thank you.
You're very welcome, sir. We appreciate your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. I'm actually impressed. Thanks again.

Have a great day and thank you for choosing VeloFit! Should you ever have any questions, please refer to our website to review the details of our standard return policy. You can also request to speak with a manager if you need further assistance.
